q: عِنْدَمَا كُنْتُ صَغِيرًا، كُنْتُ ___ كُرَةَ الْقَدَمِ كَثِيرًا.
e: When I was little, I used to play football a lot.
I used to walk to school every day.

q: كُنْتُ ___ فِي بَيْتٍ صَغِيرٍ قُرْبَ الْبَحْرِ.
e: I used to live in a small house near the sea.
I used to drink coffee every morning.
I used to write long letters to my grandmother.
I was sleeping when the phone rang.
I was watching television when my father arrived.
I used to work in a restaurant before university.

q: فِي الصَّيْفِ كُنْتُ ___ فِي النَّهْرِ مَعَ أَصْدِقَائِي.
e: In summer I used to swim in the river with my friends.
I was waiting for the bus when I saw you.
I used to believe that Arabic was very hard.
I used to dream of becoming a doctor.
I used to be afraid of dogs when I was small.
I used to buy a new book every week.

q: كُنْتُ ___ عَنْ عَمَلٍ عِنْدَمَا قَرَأْتُ الْإِعْلَانَ.
e: I was looking for a job when I read the advert.
I used to wake up at six every day.
I used to help my mother in the kitchen.
I used to prefer the city to the countryside.

q: كُنْتُ ___ فِي الشَّارِعِ عِنْدَمَا نَزَلَ الْمَطَرُ.
e: I was walking down the street when the rain came.
I used to know the names of all the students.
I always wanted to learn to play music.

q: كُنْتُ ___ فِي الْقَاهِرَةِ عِنْدَمَا وُلِدَ ابْنِي.
e: I was living in Cairo when my son was born.
Did you use to work at this company?
What were you doing when I called you?
You used to drink your tea with sugar, didn't you?

q: أَيْنَ كُنْتَ ___ قَبْلَ أَنْ تَنْتَقِلَ إِلَى هُنَا؟
e: Where did you live before you moved here?
You used to laugh a lot when you were a child.
Did you use to read books in Arabic?
Why were you crying, Ahmad?
You used to go to the club every evening.
You used to call me every day.
Did you use to ride a bike to work?
You used to leave the house early every day.
Did you know that she was ill?
Did you use to play the piano as a child?
You used to wash your hair every day.
Who were you talking to, Sara?
You used to cook delicious dishes for your children.
You were studying at university when I met you.
You used to understand everything quickly.
You used to sing old songs in the kitchen.
You used to love cats.
Where did you use to study, Layla?
You used to be afraid of the dark when you were little.
My grandfather used to write beautiful poetry.
My father used to take the train to work.
The teacher used to explain the lesson slowly.

q: كَانَ أَخِي ___ فِي الْحَدِيقَةِ عِنْدَمَا بَدَأَ الْمَطَرُ.
e: My brother was playing in the garden when the rain started.
My friend used to call me every week.
The child was crying loudly.

q: كَانَ ___ فِي بَنْكٍ قَبْلَ أَنْ يَتَقَاعَدَ.
e: He used to work in a bank before he retired.
My father used to read the newspaper every morning.

q: كَانَ عُمَرُ ___ الْبَابَ عِنْدَمَا سَمِعَ صَوْتًا.
e: Omar was opening the door when he heard a voice.
Our neighbour used to sell old cars.
The boy was looking out of the window.
The man was carrying a heavy bag.
The train used to arrive at eight.
My son always used to cry before bed.
The manager was discussing the project with the staff.
My husband used to wash the dishes after dinner.
He always used to think that he was right.
The teacher used to teach maths at our school.
My mother used to make bread at home.

q: كَانَتْ جَدَّتِي ___ لَنَا الْكُسْكُسَ يَوْمَ الْجُمُعَةِ.
e: My grandmother used to cook couscous for us on Fridays.
My sister always used to wear the red dress.
The girl was running in the garden.
Maryam was learning Arabic in Cairo.
She used to work in a big hospital.

q: كَانَتِ الْمُعَلِّمَةُ ___ لَنَا قِصَّةً كُلَّ يَوْمٍ.
e: The teacher used to read us a story every day.

q: كَانَتْ سَلْمَى ___ مَعَ صَدِيقَتِهَا عِنْدَمَا دَخَلْتُ.
e: Salma was talking with her friend when I came in.
My mother was standing at the door.
The cat used to sleep under the table.
My colleague used to work from home sometimes.
The little girl was playing with her doll when she fell asleep.
My grandmother used to live in this village.

q: كَانَتْ نُورُ ___ رِسَالَةً عِنْدَمَا دَخَلَ أَخُوهَا.
e: Nour was writing a letter when her brother came in.

q: كَانَتْ أُخْتِي ___ كُلَّ أَسْرَارِهَا فِي دَفْتَرٍ.
e: My sister used to keep all her secrets in a notebook.
We used to go to the sea every summer.
We used to stay at my grandmother's in the holidays.
We used to eat dinner together every evening.
We were watching the news when the power went off.

q: كُنَّا ___ فِي شَقَّةٍ صَغِيرَةٍ وَسَطَ الْمَدِينَةِ.
e: We used to live in a small flat in the city centre.
We used to play basketball after school.
We were waiting for the train when the rain started.
We used to laugh a lot when we were students.
We used to visit our friends on Saturdays.
We were talking about the future all night.
We used to listen to the radio every night.
We used to celebrate Eid with the whole family.
We used to draw on the walls when we were little.
We were leaving the house when my mother called.
Did you all use to study Arabic at school?
What were you all doing in the kitchen?
You all used to visit your grandfather every holiday.
You were all talking very loudly.
Where did you all live before this house?

q: كُنْتُمْ ___ فِي الْمَلْعَبِ كُلَّ يَوْمِ جُمُعَةٍ.
e: You all used to play at the stadium every Friday.
You were all laughing when the headteacher came in.
You all used to arrive on time.
Did you all use to prefer tea or coffee?
The children used to play in the street.
They used to work on the farm.
People used to drink water from the river.
The students were listening carefully to the teacher.

q: كَانُوا ___ الْقَهْوَةَ فِي الْمَقْهَى عِنْدَمَا وَصَلْنَا.
e: They were drinking coffee in the café when we arrived.
Our neighbours used to take great care of their garden.
They used to sell clothes in the market.
The workers were building a new house.
They used to run in the park every morning.
My friends used to send me lots of letters.

q: كَانَ الْمُسَافِرُونَ ___ فِي الْمَحَطَّةِ مُنْذُ سَاعَةٍ.
e: The passengers had been waiting at the station for an hour.
Our ancestors used to live in tents.
They used to speak Arabic at home.

q: يَا بَنَاتُ، هَلْ كُنْتُنَّ ___ فِي الْجَامِعَةِ نَفْسِهَا؟
e: Girls, did you use to study at the same university?
You (women) used to talk a lot in class.
You (women) used to sing the songs together.
You (women) used to take the bus every morning.
The girls were cooking in the kitchen.
They (women) used to work at the same school.
The women used to wash clothes in the river.
The female students were listening carefully to the lecture.
The mothers were waiting in front of the school.
